projectContext: Sprint 9 focuses on browser impersonation bypass using curl_cffi for TLS fingerprint spoofing to defeat YouTube bot detection. curl_cffi v0.13.0 is already installed with 31 impersonation targets available. Sprint 8 completed 9/10 caption stories (adaptive retry budgets, timing penalty integration, multilingual tests, cache staleness, abort recovery, segment quality scoring, live stream detection, worker progress, edge case tests). Sprint 9 implements: (1) ImpersonationManager with auto-detection of available targets via --list-impersonate-targets, (2) Round-robin per-call target rotation across Chrome/Firefox/Safari, (3) ImpersonationConfig dataclass in download config section, (4) Wiring impersonation into core.py yt-dlp commands (keyword search + ID-based download), (5) Wiring into audio_first.py (audio download + segment download + full video fallback), (6) Wiring into auxiliary downloaders (title_filter, speech_screening, caption_fetcher), (7) 3-tier escalation: Tier 1 always-on impersonation, Tier 2 adds extractor-args player_client bypass on 403/bot, Tier 3 combines both with cookie rotation, (8) EscalationManager with state tracking and automatic tier progression, (9) Impersonation metrics and logging, (10) Healer integration for auto-escalation on repeated 403s, (11) Comprehensive unit tests for rotation and auto-detect parsing, (12) Integration tests for escalation tier progression.

userStories.title: Create ImpersonationManager with auto-detect and round-robin rotation
userStories.description: Create a new ImpersonationManager class in src/downloader/impersonation.py that auto-detects available impersonation targets at startup by parsing yt-dlp --list-impersonate-targets output, stores them in a sorted list, and provides thread-safe round-robin rotation returning the next target on each call. This is the foundation for all impersonation features.
acceptanceCriteria: Create ImpersonationManager class in src/downloader/impersonation.py with detect_targets() method
detect_targets() runs yt-dlp --list-impersonate-targets, parses output into list of target strings
Implement get_next_target() with thread-safe round-robin rotation (threading.Lock, wrapping index)
get_impersonate_args() returns ['--impersonate', target] for the next rotated target
Handle detection failure gracefully: log warning, return empty list, get_impersonate_args() returns []
Store detected targets count and rotation stats (calls_made, unique_targets_used) for metrics
userStories.notes: Created ImpersonationManager in src/downloader/impersonation.py with ImpersonationStats dataclass. Auto-detects 31 curl_cffi targets via yt-dlp --list-impersonate-targets. Thread-safe round-robin with threading.Lock. Graceful failure handling (TimeoutExpired, FileNotFoundError, non-zero exit). Preferred targets filtering. Exported from __init__.py. Verified: 100 concurrent threads with 0 errors, sanity check passed, 0 regressions in existing tests.

userStories.title: Create EscalationManager with 3-tier bypass progression
userStories.description: Create EscalationManager class in src/downloader/impersonation.py that implements 3-tier escalation: Tier 1 (always): --impersonate only. Tier 2 (on 403/bot-detection): add --extractor-args youtube:player_client=web_safari,tv_downgraded,web. Tier 3 (continued failure): Tier 2 + trigger cookie rotation. Track per-video escalation state and provide get_escalation_args() returning the appropriate yt-dlp args for the current tier.
acceptanceCriteria: Create EscalationManager class with current_tier property (1, 2, or 3) and escalate() method
Tier 1: get_args() returns impersonation args only (from ImpersonationManager)
Tier 2: get_args() returns impersonation + ['--extractor-args', 'youtube:player_client=web_safari,tv_downgraded,web']
Tier 3: get_args() returns Tier 2 args + signals cookie rotation needed via should_rotate_cookie flag
escalate() called on 403/bot-detection errors, advances tier and logs: 'Escalation: Tier 1 -> Tier 2'
reset() returns to Tier 1 after successful download, preserving escalation stats for metrics
